messages:
sam: Heads-up: were doing a slightly different SEO pass for the launch: focus on microsite microcopy A/B, sitemap pruning (remove low-value tag pages), and ensuring JSON-LD for both the benchmark narrative and the webinar. Need owners: microcopy test, sitemap prune list, schema snippets, and redirect rules.

anya: I'll take the microcopy A/B test and anchor text variations. Hypothesis: short CTAs ("Register") vs contextual CTAs ("See benchmark & register") will affect CTR from the SERP. Will set up 2 headline variants and 3 CTA variants. Tracking via utm_content variants: micro_a / micro_b / micro_c.

kai: I'll own sitemap pruning + redirect policy. Suggest pruning tag pages older than 2019 with low traffic and canonicalizing thin pages to category hubs. Will produce a CSV: old_url, action = prune|canonicalize|redirect. For permanent consolidations use single-hop 301s.

hannah: I'll do structured data. Plan: NewsArticle schema for the benchmark narrative (helps sitelinks), Event schema for webinar, and HowTo schema for starter-kit steps. Will hand over CMS-ready JSON-LD. Also will add BreadcrumbList on microsite pages.

sam: Good. Also want to make sure community forum links don't leak poor-quality pages into the sitemap. Kai, can you strip forum tag pages from the sitemap and set `noindex` where content is duplicate?

kai: Yep. For sitemaps: generate a pruned sitemap index and keep an audit log of removed URLs. Also recommend setting low TTL on redirects for the first 72h launch window to allow quick fixes (Cache-Control: max-age=300 for 302s, then convert to 301 + longer TTL).

anya: Microcopy experiment plan: variant A = short hero headline + "Register" CTA; variant B = outcome-led headline + "See benchmark & Register" CTA. We'll run until 2k sessions or 7 days. Will push experiment flags server-side so test doesn't create duplicate canonical pages.

hannah: JSON-LD snippet for the webinar Ill add to CMS (example):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Launch Webinar","startDate":"2026-06-12T17:00:00Z","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}}
```
And NewsArticle snippet for the benchmark (will include headline, datePublished, author, and mainEntityOfPage).

sam: Redirect rules sample for Kai:
```
# direct single-hop 301 from legacy to canonical
rewrite ^/tags/old-(.*)$ /insights/$1 permanent;
# staging fallback for register endpoint
location /register { try_files $uri $uri/ /webinar-lp; }
```
Keep 302 for quick experiments and short TTL as Kai suggested.

kai: On the audit: I'll run a staging crawl once PRs merge and produce a list of any redirect chains >1 hop, pages indexed unexpectedly, and sitemap mismatches. We'll flatten chains to single 301s before GA snapshots.

anya: For internal linking, we'll add contextual anchors from product docs and community posts to the benchmark page. Use varied anchors (exact match keyword, informational phrase, and CTA) to avoid over-optimization. Example anchors: "benchmark results", "how we scaled inference", "Register".

hannah: Also recommend `noindex` for thank-you pages and session pages. Ensure thank-you URLs are excluded from XML sitemap and have `noindex, nofollow` meta.

sam: Good reminder. For analytics, tag CTAs with utm_content microcopy variants (micro_a, micro_b, micro_c) and include `experiment_id` in the submission payload so we can tie conversions to copy variants.

site-audit-bot: Preview build started for branch `marketing/microcopy-sitemap-prune` - https://staging.redwood.ai/microcopy-preview. Running staging crawl and structured-data validator.

kai: After the crawl I'll drop the prune CSV and the redirect map in the Linear ticket: https://linear.app/RW/issue/MKT-1107. If any page unexpectedly reappears in sitemap, we do emergency revert.

anya: Ownership recap: anya = microcopy A/B + anchors; kai = sitemap prune + redirects; hannah = JSON-LD + schema + breadcrumb; sam = release coordination + tracking. Sync tomorrow 11am to review staging crawl + experiment flags. :calendar:
